youtube_description:
Jesus... I gave away my Sunday, my evenings, even my lunch break. Nothing was mine. 😔

Work, family calls, favours for everyone. He hasn't kept a single hour for himself in weeks.

He: Jesus... I gave away my Sunday, my evenings, even my lunch break. Nothing was mine. 😔

Jesus: I saw every piece you handed out. You kept none for yourself.

He: I feel guilty resting when everyone needs something.

Jesus: Rest isn't stealing from them. Even I stepped away to rest.

He: I wouldn't even know what to do with an hour.

Jesus: Start small. One hour, no phone, no favours. Just sit with Me.

Jesus: The world won't fall apart if you rest tonight. I'm holding it.

“Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.”
Matthew 11:28 (BSB)
